snippet.title: [Play For Free] "HIGH SCHOOL OF THE DEAD DAY 0" Official Game Release!
snippet.description:
"HIGH SCHOOL OF THE DEAD DAY 0" is now live on G123!
Let your instincts run wild and survive the extreme with your favorite heroines!

Play Now: https://s.g123.jp/of0qn93r

This game is an HTML5 title playable on web browsers of smartphones, tablets, and PCs. There are no downloads required so you can play depending on your lifestyle: extensively on PC at home, or casually on smartphone while you’re out.

■ Basic Game Info 
Title: HIGH SCHOOL OF THE DEAD DAY 0
Genre: Survival Tower Defense
Price: Free-to-play (in-game purchases available)
Supported Languages (Planned): Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese, Korean
